sources: Associated Press (Mykolaiv dateline); Ukrainian General Staff reminder; President Zelenskyy (TSN interview via Ukrinform/Ukrainian News)
fault_line: Genuine humanitarian pause that gets 2,000 people out -- or a staged photo-op that hands Moscow propaganda while nothing moves?

sections.what_happened: The Oleshky local ceasefire took effect at 03:00 Kyiv time Oct 27 and, per AP, 'is due to last through Saturday, or longer' -- a duration detail the 0500 record did not have (FMT/AFP had said neither side stated a duration; AP/PTI now gives Saturday). Up to 2,000 residents remain stranded with dwindling food/medicine; under the deal Russia clears mined roads while Ukraine prepares evacuations; Zelenskyy warned of a high risk Russia tries to discredit the process or stage propaganda from the evacuation. Observers are due to enter Thursday (Newsmax exclusive access, per FMT/AFP). No ceasefire violation or aid-convoy movement was reported in the first hour to 06:00 .
sections.what_verified: AP wire (carried by KCAU + ETV Bharat = 1 family) + Ukrainian General Staff primary reminder + Zelenskyy primary interview; FMT/AFP confirms start but not duration
sections.what_disputed: Russia's pre-ceasefire claim (Reuters Oct 26) that Ukraine struck Oleshky 18 times with artillery and 120+ drone attacks since Oct 19; Russian outlets framing the truce as a trap (UNN analysis Oct 26); Zelenskyy's own warning that Russia may stage propaganda -- all three cut against a clean humanitarian narrative. No independent monitor is named by any side.
sections.why_matters: The ceasefire is live -- but the clock is the story: Saturday is the deadline, the roads are still mined, and nobody is named to verify it. Lead with the Saturday line + the mine-clearing condition.
sections.context: Background: FOLLOW-UP to totw-20261027-0500-01 (elevation trigger) -- Oleshky local ceasefire in effect: AP Oct 27 says it is due to last through Saturday, or longer; no violation reported in its first hour; Zelenskyy warns Russia may use the evacuation for propaganda/discrediting; Russia to clear mined roads before convoys; observers due Thursday

totw_analysis: Our read: The ceasefire is live -- but the clock is the story: Saturday is the deadline, the roads are still mined, and nobody is named to verify it. Lead with the Saturday line + the mine-clearing condition. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Genuine humanitarian pause that gets 2,000 people out -- or a staged photo-op that hands Moscow propaganda while nothing moves?
